# Apt packages for the Python Package Tests (vmaf-tune) (vmaf-tune-tests) CI job.
# One package per line; comments starting with # are ignored.

# The two real-x265 integration tests (test_codec_adapter_x265.py,
# test_codec_adapter_x265_two_pass.py; ADR-1565) encode with the
# distribution ffmpeg, which links libx265 (ffmpeg 8.0.1 on 26.04).
ffmpeg

# The vmaf CLI from MCP Smoke links zimg, its default dependency (ADR-3396).
libzimg2
